# TINA

> Self-hosted meeting capture, transcription, and agent APIs under Apache-2.0. TINA has no hosted
> API, account service, Git remote, or public issue tracker configured yet.

## Start here

- [Quickstart](/quickstart.md): build the local Docker Compose stack and get an API key.
- [Send a bot](/how-to/send-a-bot.md): send a self-hosted meeting bot and read its transcript.
- [Authentication](/authentication.md): API keys, scopes, and rotation.
- [Meetings API](/api/meetings.md): meeting bots, transcripts, recordings, and calendar routes.
- [Agent API](/api/agent.md): dispatch, chat, routines, and workspaces.
- [MCP server](/tina-mcp.md): connect an MCP client to a self-hosted gateway.
- [Deployment](/deployment.md): Compose, Lite, and Kubernetes/Helm.
- [Configuration](/configuration.md): environment variables and self-hosted services.
- [Troubleshooting](/troubleshooting.md): diagnostics for local deployments.
- [Support](/support.md): information to collect before asking for help.

## Repository policies

- `AGENTS.md`: coding-agent instructions for this local TINA checkout.
- `CONTRIBUTING.md`: local development and contribution guidance.
- `SECURITY.md`: current vulnerability-reporting status.
- `LICENSE`: Apache-2.0.
